source: ANUGA scenarios (05_anuga_scenarios.py); ESA WorldCover 2021; OpenStreetMap contributors; GEM-15 (experimental) DTM, Google Research, CC-BY 4.0 (gaps: NASADEM)
method: Exposure inside the ANUGA max-depth footprint (depth > 0.1 m) on the 30 m grid, Reach 1 only (dam → Medjerda confluence). DEM: GEM-15 (experimental) bare-earth DTM 15 m block-averaged to 30 m. Cropland = WorldCover class 40, built-up = class 50; buildings = OSM building centroids; roads = OSM highway lines of all classes incl. tracks; villages = OSM place=village|town|hamlet within 200 m of a wet cell, arrival = earliest first time depth > 0.1 m within 200 m, depth = max within 200 m.
uncertainty: Scenario exploration, not a forecast. Exposure, not damage: a wet cell is counted whatever the depth above 0.1 m. 30 m terrain without channel bathymetry; OSM buildings and roads are incomplete in rural Tunisia (counts are lower bounds); WorldCover 2021 has its own classification errors.
